name: Low Voltage Directive
impact_assessment: joint impact assessment SEC(2011) 1376 for the New Legislative Framework alignment package
evidence_rating: thin: one Commission evaluation based mainly on stakeholder views; little quantitative data
summary: The Commission's 2021 evaluation found the Directive fairly effective in creating a single market for electrical equipment and protecting safety, with no major differences in interpretation between Member States; market surveillance, especially of online sales, was the weak point. Stakeholders supplied little quantitative cost data.

indicators.objective: No monitoring indicators set in the proposal; assessed through the Commission's reports listed below

literature.citation: European Commission (DG GROW) (2021), Commission Staff Working Document: Evaluation of the Low Voltage Directive 2014/35/EU (SWD(2021) 202 final), European Commission, Staff Working Document
literature.title: Commission Staff Working Document: Evaluation of the Low Voltage Directive 2014/35/EU (SWD(2021) 202 final)
literature.method: evaluation drawing on support study (Ecorys/VVA/Deloitte), stakeholder surveys (116 manufacturers, 12 authorities), Safety Gate/RAPEX and joint market-surveillance action data
literature.outcomes: compliance rates found by market surveillance; Safety Gate alerts; costs; relevance
literature.headline: Judged the Directive relevant and effective, but market surveillance found 58% of evaluated products non-compliant (in testing targeted at suspected products). Joint actions found 58% non-conformity for hair dryers and straighteners (2016) and 80% for toasters, mixers and blenders (2015). 3,223 LVD-related Safety Gate alerts in 2005-2008 were 76% Chinese-origin, a share that stayed at 79-89% from 2009.
literature.summary_plain: The Commission found the electrical-safety rules sound on paper, but checks keep finding that many products, often imported and sold online, do not comply.
literature.quality: descriptive; risk-targeted samples overstate population non-compliance; self-evaluation
